SELECT f.total_id, COALESCE(f.fclt_nm, '-') AS fclt_nm, COALESCE(f.inst_nm, '-') AS inst_nm, COALESCE(f.daddr, '-') AS daddr, COALESCE(f.lotno_addr, '-') AS lotno_addr,
COALESCE( CASE upper(f.facility_condition) WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN '정상' WHEN 'MINOR_DAMAGE' THEN '경미한 파손' WHEN 'BROKEN' THEN '파손 / 고장' WHEN 'DESTROYED' THEN '철거됨' ELSE f.facility_condition END, '-') AS facility_condition, f.repair_required_yn,
COALESCE(to_char(f.inspected_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), '-') AS inv_dt, COALESCE(adm.sido_nm, '') AS sido_nm, COALESCE(adm.sgg_nm, '') AS sgg_nm, COALESCE(adm.emd_nm, '') AS emd_nm, w.work_id, w.work_status, COALESCE(w.work_content, '-') AS work_content, COALESCE(w.dept_nm, '-') AS dept_nm, COALESCE(w.manager_nm, '-') AS manager_nm, COALESCE(w.manager_tel, '-') AS manager_tel, COALESCE(to_char(w.plan_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '-') AS plan_date, COALESCE(to_char(w.complete_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '-') AS complete_date, w.cost, COALESCE(w.vendor_nm, '-') AS vendor_nm, COALESCE(w.contract_no, '-') AS contract_no, COALESCE(w.remark, '-') AS remark,
f.photo_1, f.photo_2, f.photo_3, f.photo_4, f.photo_5, w.before_photo, w.after_photo, to_char(w.reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reg_date FROM qfield.facility_total_view f LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT e.emd_cd, e.emd_nm, sgg.sgg_cd, sgg.sgg_nm, sido.sido_cd, sido.sido_nm FROM public.g_emd e LEFT JOIN public.g_sgg sgg ON substring(e.emd_cd, 1, 5) = sgg.sgg_cd LEFT JOIN public.g_sido sido ON substring(e.emd_cd, 1, 2) = sido.sido_cd WHERE ST_Intersects(e.geom, ST_Transform(f.geom, 4326)) LIMIT 1 ) adm ON true JOIN map.facility_office_work w ON w.total_id = f.total_id AND w.use_yn = 'y' WHERE f.total_id = #{totalId} AND f.use_yn = 'y'
AND w.work_id = #{workId}
ORDER BY w.work_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT photo_id, work_id, kind, file_name, mime_type, file_size, content, to_char(reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reg_date FROM map.facility_office_work_photo WHERE work_id = #{workId} AND use_yn = 'y' ORDER BY CASE WHEN kind = 'BEFORE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, photo_id ASC

SELECT f.total_id, COALESCE(f.fclt_nm, '-') AS fclt_nm, COALESCE(f.inst_nm, '-') AS inst_nm, COALESCE(f.daddr, '-') AS daddr, COALESCE( CASE upper(f.facility_condition) WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN '정상' WHEN 'MINOR_DAMAGE' THEN '경미한 파손' WHEN 'BROKEN' THEN '파손 / 고장' WHEN 'DESTROYED' THEN '철거됨' ELSE f.facility_condition END, '-') AS facility_condition, f.repair_required_yn, COALESCE(adm.sido_nm, '') AS sido_nm, COALESCE(adm.sgg_nm, '') AS sgg_nm, COALESCE(adm.emd_nm, '') AS emd_nm, latest.work_id, latest.work_status, COALESCE(latest.work_content, '-') AS work_content, COALESCE(latest.dept_nm, '-') AS dept_nm, COALESCE(latest.manager_nm, '-') AS manager_nm, COALESCE(latest.manager_tel, '-') AS manager_tel, COALESCE(to_char(latest.complete_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '-') AS complete_date, latest.cost, COALESCE(latest.vendor_nm, '-') AS vendor_nm, COALESCE(latest.contract_no, '-') AS contract_no FROM qfield.facility_total_view f LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT e.emd_cd, e.emd_nm, sgg.sgg_nm, sido.sido_nm FROM public.g_emd e LEFT JOIN public.g_sgg sgg ON substring(e.emd_cd, 1, 5) = sgg.sgg_cd LEFT JOIN public.g_sido sido ON substring(e.emd_cd, 1, 2) = sido.sido_cd WHERE ST_Intersects(e.geom, ST_Transform(f.geom, 4326)) LIMIT 1 ) adm ON true JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT work_id, work_status, work_content, dept_nm, manager_nm, manager_tel, complete_date, cost, vendor_nm, contract_no FROM map.facility_office_work w WHERE w.total_id = f.total_id AND w.use_yn = 'y' ORDER BY w.work_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest ON true WHERE f.use_yn = 'y' AND f.repair_required_yn = 'Y' AND latest.work_status IN
#{st}
AND adm.emd_cd LIKE #{code} || '%'
AND (f.fclt_nm ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR f.daddr ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY latest.complete_date DESC NULLS LAST, f.fclt_nm ASC
